title: Exploring Large Language Models in Healthcare: Insights into Corpora Sources, Customization Strategies, and Evaluation Metrics

bias_targets.methodology: Scoping review of primary literature that evaluates LLM outputs using expert assessments (e.g., Likert scales, presence/absence categorization, and comparison to human gold standards) to identify skewed perspectives stemming from regionally concentrated training data.

Scoping review of primary literature evaluating LLMs via expert assessments (including multiple-choice evaluation scales and unstructured feedback) to identify prejudiced or skewed perspectives related to cultural factors and a lack of cultural fidelity.

Scoping review of primary literature evaluating LLMs through expert assessments to identify biases resulting from the underrepresentation of low- and middle-income populations in digital healthcare ecosystems and training corpora.

Scoping review of primary literature highlighting gaps in socio-demographic dataset representation, evaluated through expert-assessed outcome metrics comparing model outputs with human expert-provided answers.

Scoping review of primary literature identifying gaps in corpus fairness and socio-demographic representation across different nationalities, evaluated via expert assessments and performance rankings.
